subject: Notice: TelemetryWorks subprocessor addition — Ops impact & DPA evidence
messages:
From: contracts@acmecloud.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: TelemetryWorks addition as subprocessor / DPA confirmation

Hi Marissa,

Following our onboarding plan for BrightSky Logistics (PO 112233), we wanted to notify Redwood that we intend to add TelemetryWorks Inc. as a subprocessor for metrics aggregation and anonymized telemetry starting 2026-11-01.

Summary:
- Subprocessor: TelemetryWorks Inc.
- Purpose: anonymized telemetry and metrics pipeline; no raw customer PII; hashed IDs only
- Data flows: aggregated telemetry via S3 bucket (us-west-2) -> TelemetryWorks processing -> aggregated metrics back to Acme
- Proposed flowdown: standard DPA annex + order form amendment (see attached scope PDF)

Action requested of Redwood:
1) Confirm whether the proposed subprocessor is acceptable under our current DPA or whether you require an executed flowdown (we can execute our flowdown template if that helps).
2) Provide evidence of control alignment (SOC 2 or equivalent) and any redline requests to the proposed flowdown by 2026-10-25 to meet our deployment timeline.

Attachment: Acme_TelemetryWorks_Scope.pdf

Thanks,
Jill Ramos
Contracts Manager
Acme Cloud
contracts@acmecloud.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: TelemetryWorks addition as subprocessor / DPA confirmation

Marissa — thanks for the ping. I reviewed the scope and made the following high-level recommendations (see inline in the attached redlines):

Primary legal adjustments (summary):
- Data use limitation: explicit prohibition on using telemetry for profiling or selling; permitted use limited to metrics aggregation for BrightSky only.
- No secondary processing: TelemetryWorks must not combine data with other datasets that would re-identify end-users.
- Subprocessor liability cap carve-out: retain our existing cap but add exception for gross negligence or willful misconduct related to data exposures.
- Audit rights: contractual audit every 12 months with reasonable notice; TelemetryWorks must provide SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent within 30 days of request.
- Security controls: require encryption at rest and in transit, key management details (who holds KMS keys), and egress only to approved destinations.

Operational note to Dev: ensure the S3 bucket policy requires encryption and restricts IAM roles to avoid wide read permissions. If TelemetryWorks will pull data directly, we should provide a pre-signed short-lived URL or use cross-account role with limited scope.

I attached a redlined doc (redlines_proposal_20261019.docx) with placeholders. I also flagged one clause where procurement might want a tighter SLA for telemetry freshness (Karthik).

Rishi
Head of Legal — Contracts
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment: redlines_proposal_20261019.docx

Thanks — quick procurement take. From a billing and order-form perspective:
- This looks like a standard flowdown/annex rather than a new line-item SOW. We can route this as an Order Form Amendment referencing PO 112233 and the existing MSA. That avoids changing BrightSky billing.
- Please ensure TelemetryWorks signs our standard subprocessor flowdown (we can push our template). If they require cost recovery, we need them to route charges through Acme (not Redwood).
- Checklist to attach when sending to Acme:
  - Completed vendor questionnaire
  - Latest SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 cert copy
  - Data flow diagram (we need a one-page showing S3 -> TelemetryWorks -> aggregated output)
  - Contact for security incident response and escalation matrix

I uploaded a short checklist (procurement_checklist_20261019.xlsx). Marissa — once Rishi finalizes redlines, procurement will assemble the packet and send to Acme + TelemetryWorks on 10/21.

Karthik

Hi Jill — thanks for the heads up and the scope doc. Attached is our consolidated response packet and proposed minimal redlines for the flowdown. Highlights below:

- Redwood accepts TelemetryWorks as a subprocessor subject to the attached flowdown being executed by TelemetryWorks and Acme.
- Required evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (or equivalent), one-page data flow diagram, security incident contact. Procurement has attached a checklist; please return completed items by 10/25.
- Operational requirement: TelemetryWorks must only access the S3 staging bucket via a cross-account role with time-limited credentials; no persistent credentials allowed.
- Timeline:
  - 10/21: we will send the consolidated flowdown + redlines to TelemetryWorks and Acme (DocuSign link included).
  - 10/25: deadline for evidence & any TelemetryWorks exceptions.
  - 11/01: anticipated processing start contingent on acceptance.

Next steps for Acme / TelemetryWorks: please confirm whether TelemetryWorks accepts the flowdown template or will propose specific redlines; if they propose redlines, we need them back by 10/24 so Acme can triage.
